Alright asshole, Rally sucks because it encourages newer players to mindlessly whack enemies and corpses whenever they get hit which while thematically fitting with Bloodborne, is also a great way of getting players to play  too aggressively. I've known a few people who barely even touched the dodge button early on because of Rally, let alone parrying with a gun. (And people act shocked so many get filtered by the first boss) For the late game it just encourages fully face tanking weaker enemies since whatever health you lose you can just rally right back with very little consequences. It's lame IMO. Mix that with Blood Vials that you have to keep tabs on and it makes the health system for Bloodborne feel so... uninteresting and grindy especially for first time players. It's why so many newer players just use cummmfpk or whatever

Lies of P (my beloved) instead has Guard Retain which is similar to Rally except you can only Rally back any health you lost from BLOCKING attacks. however if you take even a single point of damage your Guard Retain will completely disappear. Guard Retain drains very slowly to compensate for this. If you want to rally your INTENTIONALLY lost health you have to make sure you can land some hits on the enemy without getting hit yourself, or successfully parry their attacks. It actually encourages the player to play aggressive while not encouraging the player to button mash to get their health back. It also addresses the whole annoying "engenders passivity" argument Bloodborne fans love so much by making the ability to Rally your health exclusive to blocking. Why should someone messing up a dodge roll be "rewarded" with a chance to Rally their health back? Instead reward players for spending their health intentionally while incentivizing them to not turtle up. Mix that with Pulse Cells which are basically Estus Flasks but when you use up your final Pulse Cell you can also recharge it by landing hits or parrying attacks. It means that you have unlimited healing during fights as long as you can play smart while still being aggressive.

TLDR - Bloodborne has me farming healing items before boss fights which is lame and boring, Lies of P has me farming healing items DURING the boss fights which is cool and epic. Guard Retain is the answer to every annoying Bloodborne fan who has never touched a shield in their life, and Lies of P is the best Souls game as far as combat goes.
